steps.content: [Bureau]

The Bureau staff has reviewed all surveillance footage but hasn't found the slightest trace of the picture book. It seemingly materialized out of nowhere, left its taunt for you, then vanished without a trace. Meanwhile, Nightingale has also failed to locate the Morveth Castle so far.

Your knowledge of the castle is limited to the fact that it's in a remote satellite town that fell into abandonment during the time of the great explosion and the Black Ring. Yet, with numerous similar locales scattered across the lands, locating it would be no different than searching for a needle in a haystack.

The notion that Morveth Castle existed solely within a dream has also crossed your mind. However, the burgeoning mass of Mania pulsating within you serves as a stark reminder: Graves remains lost, gripped by fear, ensnared in a new trap.
You try hard to recall details about Morveth Castle from your dream, but only one thing repeatedly surfaces in your mind—a mysterious sequence of numbers:

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: ...Eugene, which do you think is easier: detaining an A-Class Sinner or locating an abandoned landmark?
[Castle]

steps.speaker: Graves
steps.content: That's right, I was born a monster! Born to be abandoned...
The unsettling notes of the discordant Wedding March reverberate sharply, while a storm of Mania relentlessly assaults the surroundings.
The ring floats beside Graves, insatiably draining her power. Endless waves of Mania transform into a spinning black vortex, expanding outward with Graves at its center.

steps.speaker: Graves?
steps.content: Never part? Together forever? A freak like me is cursed to be alone. This waiting, this torment... it never ends! Maybe it's just better to end it all!

At the storm's center, Graves has completely lost her original form—her body twisted into a grotesque shadow. Her dress is torn to shreds, thorn-like protrusions sprouting from her figure, slashing into the ground and walls with ruthless abandon.

The intense suction forces the chandelier to swing violently, emitting a jarring metallic screech. Pews are upturned, delicate floral ornaments are scattered, ancient plaster crumbles away in fragments from the ceiling, and fissures snake across the walls. The entire space succumbs to disorder, disintegrating bit by bit under the unstable force.
In the unbridled chaos and despair, No. 15 and Dullahan, as creations of Mania themselves, are drawn inexorably into the storm.

steps.speaker: No. 15
steps.content: Dullahan, are we going to disappear soon?

steps.speaker: No. 15
steps.content: But I haven't had the chance to teach that jerk a lesson yet. I haven't figured out what I really looked like. I haven't seen Graves find happiness in our place...

No. 15's frame rattles as its components begin to come loose, clanging in a frenzied cacophony. Bit by bit, parts break away, falling to the ground and morphing into irreparable debris. Meanwhile, Dullahan faces an equally dire fate—his armor rapidly rusts, the once vibrant flame atop his head flickering, threatening to die out at any instant.

steps.speaker: Dullahan
steps.content: We should've been gone long ago... We are but hallow vessels of longings, unable to replace true love or truly understand it. To linger here, to exist as we do—it has been an indulgence.

steps.speaker: Dullahan
steps.content: If only I could see their faces one last time... My wife, my child—they were my pride, my joy. If fate hadn't demanded my sacrifice on that battlefield... I would have shielded you, cherished you, until my last breath...
Graves can no longer hear any of their words. The Mania surges within her, showing no signs of subsiding. The twisted dark mist is slowly dragging her former friends toward the abyss.

No. 15's eyelids weigh down heavily, her gaze faltering. As her awareness drifts into the void, she grasps onto Dullahan's corroded sword hilt in a desperate attempt to keep herself from being scattered to the winds.
Dullahan calls out his wife's name from his memories, struggling to keep his last flicker of flame alive, only for it to be snuffed out by Graves's power.
Just as the storm is about to completely devour them—

steps.speaker: Familiar Figure
steps.content: Hey, buddy, now's not the time to give up!

steps.speaker: Familiar Figure
steps.content: Besides, those words only mean something if you tell them to your wife in person!

steps.speaker: Another Familiar Figure
steps.content: Graves is just manipulated by that ring right now. Now that we know the root cause, there must be a way to save her.

steps.speaker: Another Familiar Figure
steps.content: No. 15! Hang in there!

Thorns of crimson light rain down from above, violently slicing open the Mania barrier. The churning dark mist twists and dissolves in the radiance, revealing a breach torn open in the once-inescapable storm.
No. 15 opens her eyes and raises her head in disbelief, looking at you, who vanished and now return, too stunned to speak.
Hello there—though you don't look so great. This isn't the time for pleasantries. Let's find somewhere to take cover.
Long time—though I guess it hasn't been that long. This isn't the time for pleasantries. Let's find somewhere to take cover.
